entry.heading: Choose your restaurant
entry.sub: Ancient Lanzhou serves authentic hand-pulled beef noodles in Auckland and Christchurch. Select a location to view its menu, hours and ordering.

hero.title: A bowl a thousand years in the making
hero.sub: One clear broth, hand-pulled noodles and tender beef, made to order the way it has been for generations. Now in {city}.

story.title: The taste of the old Golden City
story.body1: Ancient Lanzhou (上古金城) brings the century-old craft of Lanzhou beef noodle soup to New Zealand. Every bowl begins with a broth simmered for hours with beef bone and spices, finished with noodles pulled fresh by hand for each order.
story.body2: One clear broth, two white radish, three red chilli oil, four green coriander and garlic sprouts, five golden noodles — the five colours that define a real bowl of Lanzhou beef noodles.
story.point1: Broth simmered from scratch every day
story.point2: Noodles hand-pulled to order in nine widths
